response.sql: WITH votes AS (SELECT player_id, points_won FROM player_award_vote UNION ALL SELECT player_id, points_won FROM manager_award_vote), group_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(v.points_won) AS avg_points_won FROM votes v JOIN player p ON p.player_id = v.player_id WHERE TRIM(p.death_country) <> '' GROUP BY p.death_country) SELECT death_country, avg_points_won, ABS(avg_points_won - (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) FROM group_averages)) AS distance_from_group_average FROM group_averages

assumptions.assumption: Award vote records include both player and manager award votes.
How far means absolute distance from the average across all included country groups.

alternatives.interpretation: Only player award votes are intended.
